text:
I brought my mother for dental treatment using her National Health Security Office (NHSO) benefits. She received free fillings, scaling, fluoride treatments, etc. You can check your eligibility and use the services here.

The clinic is very clean, the air conditioning is cool, and all the staff are welcoming, helpful, and willing to answer questions and provide good advice. The dentist is kind, gentle, and gives excellent advice. My mother was very impressed.

This is an excellent dental clinic! 👍🏻👏🏻🙏🏻

The doctors are friendly. You can park at The Mall Tha Phra and walk there.

The clinic is clean and the wait is short. It's very convenient.

The appointments are well-organized and on time. There's not a long wait.

I use my gold card and can use one service per day. I pay for any excess that day myself. Overall, it's good and close to home.
